# What Delightful builds (first increment, 2 Nov 2026)

**Everything here was generated by `tools/carry.py` from the source repositories and has NEVER been loaded in Horizon.**
Expect kinks. Counts are from each mod's `CARRY-REPORT.md` in `mods/<id>/`.

| Content mod | Blocks | Items | Vanilla recipes | Cooking pot | Cutting board | Source |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `farmersdelight` | 53 | 94 | 118 | 27 | 94 | github.com/vectorwing/FarmersDelight (MIT) |
| `rusticdelight` | 44 | 108 | 176 | 32 | 48 | github.com/PhantomWing/RusticDelight (MIT) |
| `expandeddelight` | 41 (2 removed) | 61 | 57 | 17 | 17 | github.com/ianm1647/expandeddelight (MIT) |
| `corn_delight` | 4 | 21 | 23 | 9 | 4 | github.com/0999312/Corn-Delight, branch 1.21 (MIT) |
| `cratedelight` | 43 (1 removed) | 0 (all block items) | 63 | | | github.com/axperty/cratedelight, branch 26.2-neoforge (MIT) |
| `storagedelight` | 169 (1 removed) | 0 (all block items) | 168 | | | github.com/axperty/storagedelight, branch 1.21.11-neoforge (MIT) |
| `dumplings_delight` | 14 | 32 | 17 | 22 | 2 | github.com/Joshcraft2002/Dumplings-Delight-Rewrapped (MIT; the port of Dumpling's Delight) |

Brewin' And Chewin' is **removed for now** (its keg needs fluids, which Cookpot lacks). Each is a separate content mod whose id is the original's namespace, so recipes and models that name another mod's
(`farmersdelight:...`) still resolve. Install `farmersdelight` first; the add-ons need it.

## How things map

- **Food items**: a `minecraft:bread` item with the food and consumable components read from the Java food definitions
  (nutrition, saturation, fast eating, effects). Bowl and bottle remainders carried.
- **Blocks**: a vanilla template guessed from the blockstate's properties, with overrides (crops by growth stages, cakes for
  pies, `tall_grass` for double plants, `farmland`, `glazed_terracotta` for facing-only decoration).
- **Cabinets and baskets**: custom chests: `minecraft:barrel` blocks (a 27-slot container with its own menu). The blockstate
  gets the up and down facings a barrel can have.
- **Cooking pot** (`farmersdelight:cooking_pot`, a Cookpot machine): 6 inputs, a container slot, an output, FD's own GUI
  texture, progress bar. **Heated by a lit campfire, soul campfire, furnace, blast furnace or smoker directly below** (or any
  block in the tag `farmersdelight:heat_sources`). All Farmer's Delight and add-on `farmersdelight:cooking` recipes.
- **Cutting board** (`farmersdelight:cutting_board`, a Cookpot `instant` machine with a screen): put an item in, get the
  results. **No knife needed** (decided). All `farmersdelight:cutting` recipes.
- **Creative tab** per mod, in the original's order. **Models, textures, sounds, particles, English text** copied.
- **Loot tables** of declared blocks copied (format unchecked against 26.3).
- **Tags** copied.

## Add-ons are separate mods

Each add-on is its own `.hmod`. **Turn one on or off in Options > Mods**; there is no settings page of our own (decided
2 Nov 2026). `farmersdelight` is required by the others.

## Rebuilding

```
git clone --depth 1 <each source repo>   # into ../src/mods/ (see the commands in tools/carry.py's header)
python3 tools/carry.py --src ../src/mods/FarmersDelight --id farmersdelight --out mods/farmersdelight   # and the others
python3 tools/prune.py mods
python3 tools/package_mods.py            # dist/*.hmod
```

## Not built yet

Nothing from the agreed list is missing except Brewin' And Chewin' (removed for now). Storage Delight's cabinets, drawers and
bookshelves are all `minecraft:barrel` blocks (27 slots each, one vanilla menu); the originals' drawer-specific slot counts are
not reproduced.
